title: adaptive-snapshot-prioritizer-and-deferred-collection-for-oncall-noise-reduction
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: On-call noise from low-signal telemetry snapshots causes responder fatigue and increases mean time to actionable context. This change implements an adaptive snapshot prioritizer that scores candidate telemetry snapshots (logs, traces, span samples, metric rollups) at alert time and defers collection of low-priority artifacts to a background window. Goals: (1) Surface high-utility context within the first 30s of an alert, (2) Reduce dispatcher load and artifact storage spikes during bursty incidents, (3) Provide operators a configurable fallback to force-collect deferred items if an incident escalates. What this PR changes: - Adds a snapshot scorer service (pluggable scoring hooks) with default heuristics: error density, anomaly score delta, user-facing traffic impact, and recent similar-alert hit-rate. - Introduces a deferred-collection queue with rate limiting and exponential backoff; low-priority items are scheduled for collection in a 5–60 minute window depending on score. - API: alert payload gets a new "snapshot_priority_hints" field (structured but encoded as a small JSON string) so downstream tooling (console, incident-bot) can render priorities. - UI: small UX affordances in the oncall compact brief (slo-toolkit renderer) to show "Deferred" badges and quick actions: force-collect / cancel-deferred / pin-snapshot. - Ops: new telemetry for prioritizer decisions, queue depth, avg deferral latency, and a sampling flag for audits. Backwards compatibility: default scoring is conservative; existing callers that don't opt-in will continue performing full collection. Migration: the prioritizer is feature-flagged (env: SLO_PRIORITIZER=on) and disabled by default for all customers; internal rollout plan attached in Linear ENG-4821. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4821) - [x] Unit tests for scorer and queue policy - [x] E2E integration test with incident-bot simulator - [x] Console UX updates behind feature flag - [x] Telemetry dashboards added in observability-pack - [x] Release notes drafted Changeset summary: commits below and high level files modified. Release notes: "Introduce adaptive snapshot prioritizer to reduce on-call noise; disabled by default behind SLO_PRIORITIZER flag. See ENG-4821 for rollout guide."

review_comments: Carlos Nguyen: Nice, lightweight heuristics. Can we make "error density" configurable per-service? Suggest adding service-level overrides stored in KV. (2026-02-17)
Maya Patel: Good call — added service_overrides to queue persistence and passed config through the scorer factory. Updated tests to cover overrides. (2026-02-18)

Priya Desai: Queue persistence looks fine but we need to ensure items are re-queued after a process restart — add a reconciliation loop. Also add a safety cutoff to avoid collecting >X GB in a window. (2026-02-18)
Maya Patel: Reconciliation loop added (queue.reconcile() on startup). Also added configurable collection_capacity_limit and a hard-coded safety fallback for now. (2026-02-19)
Liam O'Connell: UX nit: 'Deferred' badge should include expected retry time; otherwise responders don't know when to ask for forced collection. (2026-02-19)
Maya Patel: Updated renderer to show ETA and added quick action for force-collect. (2026-02-19)

manual_test_notes: Deployed to staging with SLO_PRIORITIZER=on, simulated alert flood (200 alerts/min) — observed 62% reduction in immediate artifact collections and <90s avg time-to-first-high-priority-snapshot.
Force-collect action triggers immediate collection and shows in operator timeline; cancel-deferred correctly removes queue entries.
merge_summary: Merged via squash on 2026-02-22 by Priya Desai. Commit message condensed; release notes and rollout doc attached. Feature remains gated behind SLO_PRIORITIZER; recommended gradual rollout per ENG-4821.
release_notes: Introduce adaptive snapshot prioritizer (disabled by default). Reduces immediate snapshot collection for low-priority items, provides UI badges and a force-collect action. Operational metrics added for decision auditing.
rollout_instructions: 1) Enable SLO_PRIORITIZER in internal staging teams. 2) Run smoke harness for 48h. 3) Gradually enable for 10% of customers with high incident volume. 4) Monitor prioritizer.avg_deferral_latency and queue.depth dashboards. 5) Escalate to ENG-4897 if false negatives observed.
notes_for_ops:
Ensure 'collection_capacity_limit' cluster setting is tuned before broad rollout. If storage backfill is required, use the admin CLI 'slo-prioritizer backfill --project=

' to schedule deferred items.
